Updating the root route head title and `public/manifest.json` so the tab and install name match the product (README: "Buena Context-Loom").

Here’s what was changed:

1. **`src/routes/__root.tsx`** — The root `head` meta `title` is now **`Buena Context-Loom`** (same naming as in your README), so the browser tab shows that instead of “TanStack Start Starter”.

2. **`public/manifest.json`** — `short_name` is **`Buena`** and `name` is **`Buena Context-Loom`**, so any “Add to Home Screen” / PWA label matches the product.

Reload the dev app and the tab should show **Buena Context-Loom**. Individual routes can still override this later with their own `head()` if you want page-specific titles.
